note: Chora's promotion to reviewed (P11). The entrance is the courtyard gate on Kariye Türbesi Sokağı as OpenStreetMap maps it (node 2088635511, 4.4 m from the street), matching Müze İstanbul's description of the visitor route starting at the north gate on that street. Checked remotely on 2026-11-12; a site visit stays open (O15).

currentFunction.en: A mosque since 2020, reopened on 6 May 2024; visitors enter outside prayer times, and foreign visitors pay at the door.
currentFunction.tr: 2020’den beri cami; 6 Mayıs 2024’te yeniden açıldı. Ziyaretçiler namaz vakitleri dışında giriyor, yabancı ziyaretçiler kapıda ücret ödüyor.
